clips.text: You can keep Pixel Reel on your phone. Right there on the home screen, next to the weather.
There's no app shop to visit, and nothing to pay. You press one button, and say yes.
After that, one press and it opens, like any other app. No address to type. No tab to lose.
It works with no internet, too. The reels you've watched there are kept on your phone. So they still play on the train.
And if you change your mind, take it off again, like any other app. I shan't be offended.
